name: Text case tools
author: Lienzo UI
description: Changes the capitalization of every text of the design: UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case or Sentence case.

commands.name: UPPERCASE all texts
commands.description: Converts every text and dropdown option to capitals.

commands.name: lowercase all texts
commands.description: Converts every text and dropdown option to lowercase.

commands.name: Title Case all texts
commands.description: Capitalizes the first letter of every word.

commands.name: Sentence case all texts
commands.description: Capitalizes only the first letter of each text.
